content: Vihaan Patel contacted insurance agent Neha Kapoor regarding the unexpected expiration of his health policy (SH-123456), which he thought was set for auto-renewal. He requested an investigation into the matter and guidance on the steps needed to reinstate or renew the policy.

action_items: Investigate why the policy expired despite expected auto-renewal
Provide steps to reinstate or renew the health policy SH-123456
